propositions: Commit messages with body lines exceeding 72 characters are rejected locally at commit time, naming each offending line and its length.
Commit subjects exceeding 50 characters are rejected locally with explicit error output.
Conforming commits proceed to creation and retain Gerrit's Change-Id trailer by chaining the legacy commit-msg hook without clobbering it.
Body lines matching specific carve-out patterns (trailers, TAG= lines, fenced code blocks, indented blocks, table rows, atomic tokens) are exempt from the 72-column check.
The make hooks target verifies both pre-commit and commit-msg hook installation and warns (without failure) if Gerrit's Change-Id stamping is not detected.
The checker is read-only and never mutates the commit message; enforcement is local and bypassable with --no-verify.
